title: Evaluation under availability-set casting
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree whose available coordinates are in a finite set $A$, and let $B$ be another such set with $A=B$. For every input $x$, casting $T$ to have available set $B$ leaves its evaluation unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ and $B$ are finite sets of coordinates among the $n$ inputs
$T$ is a finite decision tree with available set $A$
An input $x$ on the $n$ coordinates is given
